params.body:
Five small UI points decided by the owner on 17 September 2026 (open points from the work session with Ilse of 11 September), one pull request.

## What changed for the dealer

1. **Showroom switch on the Data tab.** It already sat there since 14 September (own "Showroom" heading between Stocklist and Website, before the portals) on both the classic and the Livewire sheet; nothing else on the sheet carries it. This PR pins that with a test (both sheets, every other tab checked for a leftover), updates R S1-3.17 and closes open point O-14. Field name and what is saved are unchanged.
2. **Button capitalisation.** The chassis-number modal's button read "importeer". `ButtonLabelCapitalizationTest` only checked a fixed list of `global.*` keys; `global.import` was never on it. The test now sweeps every `<button>` in every blade: a label that is one `trans()`/`__()` call is resolved in nl, fr, en and de, a literal label is read as written. Labels it found and that are sentence case now:
   - `global.import` (nl "Importeer", fr "Importer", en "Import", de "Importieren")
   - `algemeen.opslaan` (nl/fr/en/de; the save button of roles, options, requirements, useful links, dealers, users, simple CRUD)
   - `export.place_bidding` (nl "Plaats bod", fr, en), `export.show_client` (nl "Toon aan klant", fr, en)
   - `warranty.history_send` (nl "Verzend historiek", fr, en, es)
   - `user.reset` de "Zurücksetzen"; `user.bevestigen` de "Bestätigen" (was "bestätigt Sie")
   - untranslated placeholders: `vehicle.resetall` fr/en/de ("resetall eng" and friends, the demo reset button) and `damage.extra_damage` en ("extra_damage eng")
   - Excluded on purpose: `trans.months`, the unit affix beside the warranty field ("12 maanden"), listed in the test with its reason.
3. **Remaining tokens as text.** The modal showed the balance in a disabled input; it is now a quiet box with "174 tokens over" (`vehicle.vin_tokens_left`, plural-aware, nl/fr/en/de/es). Nothing is posted. R S1-2.2 updated.
4. **Chassis-first hint.** Under the buttons of a new sheet (classic header and the Livewire preview head), also on the phone: "Aangeraden: via chassisnummer (vult de fiche uit de Europese databanken). Manueel kan ook; het chassisnummer kan later nog opgehaald worden." in nl/fr/en/de(/es). Not shown once the vehicle is complete. New rule R S1-2.18; open point O-01 closed with the owner's decision (both ways, with the recommendation; not "chassis first, manual as a link").
5. **Car-Pass button reads "Car-Pass registreren"** (`vehicle.do_carpass_request`; fr "Enregistrer le Car-Pass", en "Register Car-Pass", de "Car-Pass registrieren", es "Registrar Car-Pass"). Lang files only; the confirmation dialog title follows the same key ("Car-Pass registreren?"). **Rule change not written in this PR:** the S3 chapter (R S3-2.1, S3-2.4, S3-2.13 and the section title "S3-2 Car-Pass aanvragen") still names the button "Car-Pass aanvragen"; another agent is working on that file, so those rows follow separately. Open point O-04 marked afgewerkt.

Open points O-02 (notice before the button, already so since PR 114) and O-25 (observer clean-up, done 14/09) closed as done. The decisions are recorded as `klant:beslissingen#open-punten-2026-09-17` so the rule rows derive `klant`. The "sterren" point is untouched; it waits for Ilse.

## Tests

- `ButtonLabelCapitalizationTest` (extended with the blade sweep; mutation-checked: lowering `global.import` back makes it fail on exactly that key)
- `AddVehicleOpenPointsTest` (new): showroom switch on Data only, both sheets; tokens as text and "Importeer"; hint on both sheets, not on a complete vehicle; hint in every language
- Updated for the new Car-Pass label: `OwnStockRowMarkupTest`, `FrenchTranslationsTest`, `CarpassPollingAndPendingTest`
- Green locally: `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesSourcesTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `SmokeTest` (263 tests), `bin/rules-coverage`, `bin/rules-sources`

No hot shared files touched (`ui.php`, `refresh.css`, `app.blade.php`, `_wagen_rij.blade.php`, `SmokeTest.php` unchanged). Tailwind utility classes only, no new `ui-` classes.
params.title: Open points: showroom switch on the Data tab, button capitalisation, tokens as text, chassis-first hint
